C1.what: one registration macro and module.cpp are required
C1.fix: add module.cpp with exactly one WS_REGISTER_MODULE registration

C2.what: source file lacks the required SPDX license identifier
C2.fix: put the correct SPDX-License-Identifier comment at the top of the source

C3.what: portable DSP source includes a banned library header
C3.fix: remove dynamic allocation, I/O, thread and container headers from portable DSP sources

C4.fix: correct the descriptor IDs, counts, callbacks, finite parameter ranges and initial values

C5.what: module.json does not match the runtime descriptor
C5.fix: make module.json id, name and port/parameter IDs agree with the descriptor, or remove obsolete metadata

C6.what: portable-tier symbol report has warnings or is unavailable
C6.fix: inspect the undefined-symbol groups and optional cross-compile diagnostics; C6 is advisory in v0

BUILD.fix: correct the first compiler/linker error; do not change locked native product files

ENV.fix: install a C++17 toolchain, CMake and Ninja/Make or a Visual Studio generator

USAGE.what: module folder or argument is invalid
USAGE.fix: pass a readable module folder and use --help for the supported arguments

STAGE.what: this runner stage has not been implemented
STAGE.fix: use check now; test and render arrive in separate MT2/MT3 tasks

T1.fix: correct descriptor IDs, counts, callbacks, ranges and initial parameter values

T2.fix: support the sample rate or document refusal; hosts cannot load the module at that rate

T3.fix: accept arbitrary frame counts via b.frames() and never exceed output channel capacity

T4.fix: index all per-voice state by channel; size storage to the supported voice count

T5.fix: seed randomness from config.seed and remove static mutable DSP state

T6.what: reset differs from a fresh module
T6.fix: reset every state member changed by processing

T7.what: state round-trip or truncated load failed
T7.fix: save every output-affecting state member and reject truncated payloads

T8.what: process or reset allocated heap memory
T8.fix: allocate in prepare through the host allocator; never allocate inside process or reset

T9.what: nonfinite input was not safely rejected or clamped
T9.fix: reject invalid input with zeroed constant output, or return finite output

T10.fix: flush sufficiently small state or add a tiny DC offset; this is report-only

T11.what: parameter extreme produced invalid or excessive output
T11.fix: limit the parameter range or document peaks beyond 4 full-scale

T12.what: fast parameter sweep produced nonfinite output or clicks
T12.fix: smooth modulatable parameters per sample and guard nonfinite values

T13.fix: update coefficients per sample or smooth across block boundaries; this is report-only
